package.description: Measures your real ping while you play.

en-US.description: Measures your real ping while you play.
en-US.longDescription: PingRank finds the game you are running, finds the server the game talks to, and times the round trip. Players who share their recordings power the ISP rankings at pingrank.gg.
en-US.name: PingRank.gg
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's changed
- No changes to the app. This release tests automatic updates from v0.8.0.

Build details
Windows files carry an Authenticode signature from Open Source Developer Boden Phillip Garman.
Built from source by GitHub Actions: https://github.com/bpbp-boop/pingrank-cli/actions/runs/41264230664
Verify provenance with: gh attestation verify --owner bpbp-boop
Or check its SHA-256 against checksums.txt.
